listing.title: Zero Waste Personal Care Kit - Plastic-Free Daily Essentials for Bathroom
listing.body_text:
Every plastic bottle in your bathroom has a better alternative. This kit has five of them.

Zero Waste Personal Care Kit is Bare Necessities' personal care starter kit — five handcrafted products designed to replace the plastic from your daily bathroom routine, one swap at a time. Body care. Lip care. Skin care. Oral care. All covered. All plastic-free.

This is not just a gift. It's a starting point. The kit that proves switching to zero waste doesn't mean compromising on quality, effectiveness or experience. Bare Necessities was named one of India's best zero waste personal care brands in 2026 by Suspire — and this kit is exactly why.

What's inside — and what it replaces:

Espresso Yourself Coffee Body Scrub (90g) Recycled coffee grounds from Bengaluru's favourite cafés — given a second life on your skin before returning safely to the earth. Caffeine stimulates circulation, grounds exfoliate dead skin cells and tan, coconut oil nourishes. Replaces a plastic body scrub or exfoliating gel. Smells exactly like freshly brewed coffee.

Busy Bee Lip Balm (20g) A deeply nourishing lip balm with coconut oil, shea butter and a natural protective wax — the everyday handbag essential that replaces petroleum jelly and plastic lip balm tubes. Keeps lips soft through every season. Lasts 1+ years.

Soak It up Moisturiser (20g) A lightweight, non-greasy plant-based moisturiser for face and body — jojoba, apricot and hemp seed oils. Non-comedogenic, suitable for all skin types. Replaces a plastic moisturiser bottle — and absorbs in seconds.

Compostable Bamboo Toothbrush FDA-approved, charcoal-bristled and compostable bamboo handle. The swap that most people make first — and the one that makes zero waste living feel real. 4.7 billion plastic toothbrushes are discarded every year. This is not one of them.

Soothe Operator Handmade Soap Bar (75g) A cold-processed soap bar with calamine clay, glacial green clay and rose geranium essential oil — naturally rich in glycerin that commercial soaps strip out. Replaces a plastic liquid body wash bottle. Gentle enough for daily face and body use.

Together this kit eliminates: Plastic body wash bottle. Plastic moisturiser tube. Plastic toothbrush. Plastic lip balm tube. Plastic scrub container. Five plastic items — replaced permanently.

Perfect for: Anyone starting their zero waste journey, gifting a conscious lifestyle switch, corporate sustainability onboarding kits, employee wellness hampers, Diwali, Christmas, birthdays and anyone whose bathroom still has more plastic than it should.

Handcrafted in India by India's first B Corp certified personal care brand.

MRP: Rs.1198/- incl. of all taxes (long lasting investment for the environment and your bank account, think about it!)
